title: Multipartite quantum synchronization in driven-dissipative spin networks
summary: Traditional studies of quantum synchronization in finite-dimensional spin systems usually focus on entrainment of a single spin to an external drive, leaving mutual synchronization among multiple spins poorly understood. We investigate mutual quantum synchronization across bipartite and tripartite spin architectures in a driven-dissipative cavity-coupled quantum Rabi network in the dispersive adiabatic regime.
